{{Quote|Apparently, due to constant Imperial attacks, we have been unable to provide adequate payment to contractors working at a secret Rebel shipyard. One of the engineers has turned traitor... [...] This engineer is planning to sell the Corellian corvette to the Ghrag Mercenary Clan! Fortunately - the remaining engineers on-board the vessel are loyal to the Alliance and will re-take the bridge if you can disable the starship.|An Alliance officer, to a Rebel pilot|<ref name="SWG:SCHascoAeraCC" />}}
The '''''Vallent IX''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was captured in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by a traitorous Alliance engineer who planned to deliver it to the [[Ghrag Mercenaries]]. However, the ship was retaken by Rebel forces and the [[Civilian Protection Guild]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG:SCHascoAeraCC" />
